gen-gf-paprika-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads compact and tall, its round letters cupped and its x-height nearly level with the caps. But Paprika's scattered, capital-like lowercase is what you remember, a heading that fills the line with swagger.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-alexandria: Alexandria stands tall in sans-serif form, its terminals generously open and its stems short above and below the body. Paprika shouts in big headings; Alexandria does the quiet, steady carrying.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-amiko: Amiko reads modern and upright, its terminals pointing outward like tongs. Paprika brings the pair's loudest trait: lowercase that fills the line like capitals, with scattered spacing that never lets things sit still.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-bangla: Approachable is the word for Anek Bangla, with wide s curves barely curled in. Paprika's commanding capitals-for-lowercase headings hand off to it smoothly, so extended text moves along without ever feeling cramped.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari keeps its letter mouths distinctly open, with a tall middle zone. Paprika's scattered, commanding heading letters make the sharper impression, and the sans below simply lets that voice carry.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-gujarati: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, scattered wide. That swagger earns its keep in big, short headings, while Anek Gujarati backs it up with a gaping c opening.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Every small letter carries a large, open counter, so the text reads clean and generous. Anek Gurmukhi handles that quiet clarity, while Paprika does the shouting, its capital-sized lowercase made for headings.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-kannada: Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, scattered across a wide stretch of space. And Anek Kannada, with its high woodblock-square x-height, sits beside it like a sturdy, modern foil.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-latin: Paprika announces itself with scattered letters and lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals. And Anek Latin, a sans-serif whose curves stay held open, can drop to a modest size without losing clarity.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-malayalam: Paprika's scattered lowercase stretches wide to fill the line like capitals. Anek Malayalam, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly meets the caps, sits beside it as a clean, quiet counterweight.
